name: Exp_FiboCandles
summary: This EA trades based on the FiboCandles custom indicator, which uses Fibonacci ratio levels to identify trend direction changes. It opens buy positions when the trend shifts upward and sell positions when the trend shifts downward, with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit settings.
summary_zh: 该EA基于FiboCandles自定义指标进行交易，利用斐波那契比率水平来识别趋势方向的变化。当趋势向上转变时开多仓，趋势向下转变时开空仓，并具有可配置的资金管理、止损和止盈设置。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于FiboCandles指标的趋势跟踪策略，该指标通过斐波那契比率（0.236、0.382、0.500、0.618、0.762）对K线进行分类来判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区4的值从0变为1时产生买入信号并开多仓，从1变为0时产生卖出信号并开空仓。出场条件包括：反向信号触发时平仓（如买入信号出现时平空仓），以及止损/止盈触发时平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode模式控制，支持按自由保证金、余额、亏损后保证金或固定手数四种模式计算仓位大小。资金管理方面提供了五种保证金模式选择，但缺乏根据市场波动性动态调整仓位的机制。策略在检测到趋势反转时同时执行平仓和开仓操作，实现了从旧趋势到新趋势的快速切换。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following approach based on the FiboCandles indicator, which classifies candles using Fibonacci ratios (0.236, 0.382, 0.500, 0.618, 0.762) to determine trend direction. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when indicator buffer 4 shifts from 0 to 1, opening a long position; a sell signal is generated when it shifts from 1 to 0, opening a short position. Exit conditions include closing positions on reverse signals (e.g., closing shorts when a buy signal appears) and stop loss/take profit levels. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter and MMMode, supporting four modes: free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, or fixed lot size. Money management offers five margin calculation modes, but lacks dynamic position adjustment based on market volatility. The strategy simultaneously executes close and open operations upon detecting trend reversals, enabling rapid transitions from old to new trends. Additionally, it includes a new bar check mechanism to avoid redundant signal processing within the same bar.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Margin usage ratio for lot size calculation

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（自由保证金/余额/亏损后保证金/亏损后余额/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Position sizing mode (free margin/balance/net loss/fixed lots)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于获取交易信号的K线索引

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于斐波那契比率的趋势跟踪方法有理论支撑
提供多种资金管理模式选择，灵活性较高
具有新K线检测机制，避免同一K线内重复交易
买卖开关独立控制，可以灵活配置只做多或只做空
使用止损和止盈设置，具备基本的风险控制
指标句柄检查和历史数据加载确保数据完整性
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on Fibonacci ratio trend following with theoretical foundation
Multiple money management modes provide flexibility in position sizing
New bar detection mechanism prevents redundant trades within the same bar
Independent buy/sell switches allow flexible configuration for long-only or short-only trading
Stop loss and take profit settings provide basic risk control
Indicator handle validation and history data loading ensure data integrity
cons: 依赖自定义指标FiboCandles，指标源码不可见导致策略透明度不足
止损和止盈为固定点数，未考虑市场波动性（如ATR）进行动态调整
缺乏加仓和减仓机制，仓位管理较为单一
未对交易时段进行过滤，可能在低流动性时段产生不利交易
缺少追踪止损功能，无法在趋势延续时锁定更多利润
无回撤控制机制，持续亏损时无法自动降低仓位
cons_en: Depends on custom FiboCandles indicator whose source code is not visible, reducing strategy transparency
Fixed stop loss and take profit in points without dynamic adjustment based on market volatility (e.g., ATR)
Lacks position scaling mechanisms (adding or reducing positions), making position management simplistic
No trading session filter, potentially generating unfavorable trades during low liquidity periods
Missing trailing stop functionality, unable to lock in more profits during trend continuation
No drawdown control mechanism to automatically reduce position size during consecutive losses
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈计算，使风险控制适应市场波动性变化
添加追踪止损功能，在趋势延续时保护浮盈并获取更大利润空间
增加最大回撤限制和连续亏损后的仓位缩减机制，提高资金安全性
添加交易时段过滤和点差过滤，避免在不利市场条件下交易
增加持仓检查逻辑，避免在已有同方向持仓时重复开仓
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit calculation to adapt risk control to market volatility changes
Implement trailing stop functionality to protect floating profits and capture larger trend moves
Add maximum drawdown limits and position reduction after consecutive losses to enhance capital safety
Add trading session filter and spread filter to avoid trading under unfavorable market conditions
Add position check logic to prevent duplicate entries when same-direction positions already exist

risk_points: 止损设为1000点较大，在波动剧烈的市场中可能造成较大单笔亏损
依赖单一自定义指标信号，缺乏多重确认机制可能导致虚假信号入场
未检查现有持仓方向，可能产生同方向重复开仓的风险
无最大回撤控制，极端行情下可能持续加码亏损
risk_points_en: Stop loss of 1000 points is relatively large, potentially causing significant single-trade losses in volatile markets
Relies on a single custom indicator signal without multi-confirmation, risking false signal entries
No check for existing position direction, potentially causing duplicate same-direction entries
No maximum drawdown control, risking continued losses during extreme market conditions

summary_en: This EA trades based on the FiboCandles custom indicator, which uses Fibonacci ratio levels to identify trend direction changes. It opens buy positions when the trend shifts upward and sell positions when the trend shifts downward, with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit settings.
